itemized.notes: 7-page filing: p1 cover (April 5 box checked; NEITHER amendment box ticked; Sim Gill, Democrat, District Attorney; signed 4-5-10, clerk-stamped APR 05 2010), p2 Summary Page, p3 printed Schedule A ('- SEE ATTACHED -'), p4-p5 the CONTRIBUTIONS attachment (typed spreadsheet, 76 rows, columns Date / First Name / Last Name / Mailing Address / City / State / Zip Code / Occupation / Employer / Amount), p6 printed Schedule B ('- SEE ATTACHED -'), p7 the EXPENDITURES attachment (typed, 22 rows). The two contributions pages are stored ROTATED in the PDF; geometry is converted back to the portrait page as poppler renders it, so each contributions row's band is a VERTICAL strip. REDACTION: on both contributions pages the Mailing Address / City / State / Zip Code columns are covered by a solid white block - at most a single leading character of the street line survives - so NO city/state was recoverable for any of the 76 donors and none was inferred. Five contributor rows have an empty First Name cell because the contributor is an organization whose whole name sits in the Last Name column (Operating Engineers Local 3 - District 12 PAC; Winder & Counsel; G & A Enterprises; Bonneville Research; Crowe-Jones Enterprises) - recorded as the organization name, flagged per row. Column B of the Summary Page (aggregate) reads $87,384 contributions / $29,373.07 expenditures - far larger than Column A, consistent with an April interim early in the cycle.
